Later fullUrl issue-family decisions already on the combined branch refined id-disagreement wording, RESTful type/id matching, arbitrary URI schemes, and batch/transaction omission exceptions. Current source search did not find remaining obvious canonical conformance-resource fullUrl examples needing this seed fix.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml already says fullUrl may be a URN or non-id-ending absolute URL, RESTful-looking fullUrls must match resource type and id, and fullUrl is not the canonical URL but an endpoint URL.
